MODEL_KEY.description: Your model provider's API key (default provider: DeepSeek — get one at [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com)). Stored encrypted in your own Cloudflare account. You can leave this empty now and paste it into the workspace's Settings later. After deploying, protect the workspace with Cloudflare Access and set OWNER_EMAIL, ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN and ACCESS_AUD — until then the workspace stays closed (see docs/deploy.md).
